title: Initial release
description: First public release of Auto Auth.

Added: Auth config (.voiden-auth/auth.yaml) mapping APIs to auth scripts by URL prefix and/or folder
Auth scripts run in Node.js, with require() for helper files, project packages and Node modules, and an auth.send() helper with {{variable}} support
Approval before a script runs, repeated whenever the script or a file next to it changes; enforced in the main process
Headers cached per project, environment and service until expiry (read from JWTs automatically), with one shared login for parallel requests
Status bar item following the open request, with every service's token state on hover
Commands: Create example config, Clear cached tokens, Forget allowed scripts
